title: Servicing System Reference — Farmstead Splits: Releasing the Homesite from a Farm Real Estate Loans Mortgage
content:
**Product:** Farm Real Estate Loans · **Subject:** the farmstead split — release of the homesite parcel while the other parcels stay mortgaged

## The rule

A farmstead split releases the homesite, the parcel of land use farmstead still mortgaged, so that it can secure separate home financing, while the other parcels stay mortgaged.

A homesite release is not recorded until the principal standing on the loan, less the release price at the product's standard release premium on the homesite's appraised value at mortgage, already sits within the post-split loan-to-value limit of the parcels that stay mortgaged.

The release price is set only once the records carry the late charge owed on every installment that was paid in full after its grace period.

## Business effect

| Before | After the release is recorded |
|---|---|
| The homesite parcel is mortgaged to the loan | The parcel shows as released, dated that day, with the release reason farmstead split and its recorded details carried over |
| Principal stands at its earlier balance | The release price is applied to principal as release proceeds; the principal balance falls by the release price |
| The appraised value still mortgaged includes the homesite | The value still mortgaged falls by the homesite's value |
| Fees owed stand at their earlier figure | The release fee is assessed; fees owed rise by it |

## Tool: `release_farmstead_parcel_0569f2e2`

**What it does.** It releases one mortgaged homesite parcel from a farm real estate loan as a farmstead split: it records the release of the parcel named by its mortgage record, dated today, with the release reason farmstead split and the parcel's recorded details carried over; applies the release price to the loan's principal as release proceeds; and assesses the release fee. Afterwards the history shows the release-proceeds payment and the fee, both pointing to the release record.

**How it is invoked.** It is a servicing-desk tool, owned by the agent: the desk unlocks `release_farmstead_parcel_0569f2e2` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the member's farm real estate loan, read from the farm real estate loan lookup | the loan number as shown on the loan record |
| `source_action_id` | the reference number of the mortgage record of the homesite parcel to be released, read from the parcel lookup for the loan | the mortgage record reference as shown in the parcel history |
| `release_price` | the release price applied to principal as release proceeds | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive |
| `release_fee` | the partial release fee the product carries for a release on sale or farmstead split | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the release record reference (an id beginning `rel_`), the parcel number, the loan number, the release price applied and the release fee in USD with 2 decimal places, and the loan's new principal balance and appraised value still mortgaged. The release reference means the parcel is released. No other return or error is defined for this tool.

## Questions this page answers

**Which parcel is the homesite?** The parcel of land use farmstead still mortgaged to the loan.

**What stays mortgaged?** The other parcels.

**When may the homesite release be recorded?** A homesite release is not recorded until the principal standing on the loan, less the release price at the product's standard release premium on the homesite's appraised value at mortgage, already sits within the post-split loan-to-value limit of the parcels that stay mortgaged.
